title: TrendAI™ Ranks First on CyberGym Agentic AI Security Benchmark
summary: TrendAI™ Ranks First on CyberGym Agentic AI Security Benchmark PR Newswire
body: TrendAI™ Ranks First on CyberGym Agentic AI Security Benchmark PR Newswire
summaryZh: TrendAI在CyberGym Agentic AI安全基准测试中夺得榜首，标志着其在智能体系统安全性与防御能力方面取得了显著的测评成果。原始信息显示：TrendAI™ Ranks First on CyberGym Agentic AI Security Benchmark PR Newswire。该消息由PR Newswire发布，主题为“TrendAI™ Ranks First on CyberGym Agentic AI Security Benchmark”。其重要性主要体现在：该文章报道了TrendAI在CyberGym智能体AI安全基准测试中排名第一的进展，属于模型测评方向的动态。建议结合原文核对关键数据、适用条件、技术限制与后续更新，以判断其对实际产品和研发决策的影响。
